name: Estival-Zij
description: Glacier upon glacier, blue-white and creaking, buried in places by nitrogen snow. The shell is broken in places by orbital debris ring, and through those breaches the deep ocean breathes plumes of frost into the dark.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
automated beacon of unknown purpose changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants trade fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
